news.title: China emerges as dry bulk export powerhouse
news.summary: China’s transformation from the world’s dominant dry bulk importer into an increasingly significant exporter is gathering pace, with outbound cargo volumes more than doubling since 2020 and accounting for nearly two-thirds of global dry bulk shipment growth this year.
